description: The contact-map composition operator inside Protein_Folding_Operator. Its input is one retained whole-chain atomic conformation, native mixed contact state, source covalent donor/acceptor frames, protonation alternatives, and a bank of candidate site pairs. Each local directional-contact component describes one coupled donor/acceptor pair. Determine how these local operands compose into the whole-chain folding operation through the SIXTEEN_3 lattice, branching, fusion, reversal and protected return. Specify computable domain actions for candidate pairs acting jointly or as retained alternatives, donor/acceptor and protonation distinctions, and the conformation transformation on the same carried state. Preserve conflicting evidence, all source ancestry and banked alternatives. Every distinction must be justified from the lattice. The fixed-point closure and mechanical stability must be one operation. The current implementation sums all candidate contacts around one proton per donor; resolve that operand binding rather than assuming it. Do not introduce arbitrary angle slots, distance gates, fitted force weights or reference structure coordinates. Return explicit geometric or matrix relations wherever the domain action requires them. The boundary is the contact-map composition and its return into the containing whole-chain folding operator.

reentry.subject: The contact-map composition operator inside Protein_Folding_Operator. Its input is one retained whole-chain atomic conformation, native mixed contact state, source covalent donor/acceptor frames, protonation alternatives, and a bank of candidate site pairs. Each local directional-contact component describes one coupled donor/acceptor pair. Determine how these local operands compose into the whole-chain folding operation through the SIXTEEN_3 lattice, branching, fusion, reversal and protected return. Specify computable domain actions for candidate pairs acting jointly or as retained alternatives, donor/acceptor and protonation distinctions, and the conformation transformation on the same carried state. Preserve conflicting evidence, all source ancestry and banked alternatives. Every distinction must be justified from the lattice. The fixed-point closure and mechanical stability must be one operation. The current implementation sums all candidate contacts around one proton per donor; resolve that operand binding rather than assuming it. Do not introduce arbitrary angle slots, distance gates, fitted force weights or reference structure coordinates. Return explicit geometric or matrix relations wherever the domain action requires them. The boundary is the contact-map composition and its return into the containing whole-chain folding operator.
